research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: NaCl rocksalt 2-atom primitive cell
purpose: Ionic-conductor reference + L1.5 phonon smoke test fixture (rocksalt NaCl has well-characterised acoustic phonon dispersion).

sources.locator: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics 90th ed., NaCl crystallographic data

notes: Conventional cubic a = 5.6402 Å; primitive 2-atom rhombohedral representation. Na at (0,0,0); Cl at (1/2,1/2,1/2). Space group Fm-3m (#225).
